name: My Kinky Boss
source: It's your first time entering the fetish scene. Hot encounters will follow when a dashing masked man helps you explore your wildest fantasies, but what will happen when you learn his identity?
translation: 這是你第一次踏入性癖圈。一位風度翩翩的蒙面男子帶你探索最狂野的幻想，一場場火熱的邂逅隨之而來。可當你得知他的真實身分，一切又會如何發展？
